cards.audioText: N: [Your flight number is CSN905, a flight from Changchun to Wuhan. You are cruising at 10400m, you are approaching BIDOG. Your squawk number is 2332. Make the initial contact with Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的呼号是南方905，一架从长春飞往武汉的航班。你现在在10400米巡航，你正接近BIDOG，你的应答机编码是2332。与北京区调建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN905, maintaining 10400m, approaching BIDOG, squawking 2332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南方905，正保持10400米，接近BIDOG，应答机2332。

cards.audioText: C: CSN905, Beijing Control, radar contact, change your squawk number to 0423.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方905，北京区调，雷达看见了，应答机编码改为0423。

cards.audioText: C: CSN905, reduced to Mach point 75 due to flow restrictions in the Zhengzhou Control area.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方905，由于郑州管制区流控限制，速度减小至点75。
cards.referenceText: Roger, reduce to Mach point 75, CSN905.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，速度减小至点75，南方905。

cards.audioText: C: CSN905, descend to and maintain 9,200m, rate of descent at 2,000 ft/min or greater.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方905，下9200米保持，下降率2000英尺每分或更大。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 9,200m at 2,000 ft/min or greater, CSN905.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下9200米保持，下降率2000英尺每分或更大，南方905。

cards.audioText: N: [A cold front is passing Beijing Control area, numerous thunderstorms are coming from the west, request Beijing Control that you want to climb to 11600m.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【冷锋正在穿越北京管制区，西侧有大量雷暴天气正在靠近，向北京区调申请，你想上116000米。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN905, request climb to 11600m due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南方905，由于天气，请求上11600米。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN905, negative, higher levels are occupied, advise your intentions.
N: [Advise the controller you wish to turn left and track direct to WXI.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方905，不可以，更高的高度被占用，告知你的意图。
N：【告知管制员，你向左转直飞WXI。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, request turn left and track direct to WXI, CSN905.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求左转直飞WXI，南方905。

cards.audioText: C: CSN905, negative, do not deviate off course.
N: [Advise controller that if there is no other options are available to avoid the weather, you will have to divert to Beijing airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【告知管制员，如果没有别的办法来避开天气，你就只能备降北京机场。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN905, if there is no other options are available to avoid the weather, request divert to Beijing airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南方905，如果没有别的办法来避开天气，我们就只能备降北京机场。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN905, 11,000m is available now, advise your intentions.
N: [Tell Beijing Control that you can accept 11,000m.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方905，11000米现在可用，告知你的意图。
N：【告知管制员，你可以接受11000米。】
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，我们可以接受11000米，南方905。

cards.audioText: C: CSN905, climb to and maintain 11,000m, turn left parallel to your course.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方905，上11000米保持，左转，保持与当前航迹平行。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 11,000m, turn left parallel to our course, CSN905.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上11000米保持，左转，保持与当前航迹平行，南方905。

cards.audioText: N: [You observed a flash of lightning and heard a loud thud. Your transponders have malfunctioned, notify Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你观察到闪电并听到一声巨响。应答机故障，现通知北京区调。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN905, we have observed a flash of lightning and heard a loud thud, transponders have malfunctioned.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南方905，我们观察到闪电并听到一声巨响，应答机故障了。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN905, I have lost your altimetry readout, confirm you are still maintaining 11,000m.
N: [Tell Beijing Control you are maintaining 11,000m, and request immediate left turn to a heading of 180 degrees.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方905，你的高度数据已消失，请确认你是否仍保持在11000米。
N: 【告知北京区调，你正保持11000米。请求立即左转航向180度。】
cards.referenceText: Maintaining 11,000m and request an immediate left turn to a heading 180 degrees, CSN905.
cards.referenceTextZh: 正保持11000米，请求立即左转航向180度，南方905。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN905, roger, left heading of 180 degrees approved, what is your status?
N: [Readback the controller's instructions and notify Beijing Control that some electrical equipment have malfunctioned, including the transponders.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方905，收到，可以左转航向180度。你那边状况如何？
N: 【复诵管制的指令，通知北京区调，部分电子设备包括应答机发生故障。】
cards.referenceText: Left heading of 180 degrees, some electrical equipment have malfunctioned, including the transponders, CSN905.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向180度，部分电子设备包括应答机发生故障，南方905。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN905, roger, advise when clear of the weather. You are expected to descend shortly.
N: [You decided to continue flight to Wuhan. You are now cruising at 7,800m over WXI, make an initial contact with Zhengzhou control.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方905，收到，脱离天气后告知。预计你一会就下降。
N：【你决定继续飞往武汉，你现在在7800米巡航，过WXI，与郑州区调建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, CSN905, maintaining 7,800m, over WXI.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，南方905，正保持7800米，过WXI。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN905, Zhengzhou Control, give a full position report.
N: [Provide the following Information in your position report: You are cruising at 7,800m, overhead WXI at 1215. Your ETA to the next way point AKOMA is 1235. The waypoint after that is ZHO.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方905，郑州管制，做一个完整的位置报。
N：【在位置报中，提供以下信息：你正在7800米巡航，在12点15分飞跃WXI，预计过航路点AKOMA时间12点35分，下一点是ZHO。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, CSN905, maintaining 7,800m, overhead WXI at 1215, ETA AKOMA at 1235, next ZHO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，南方905，保持7800米，在12点15分飞跃WXI，预计过航路点AKOMA时间12点35分，下一点是ZHO。
